Some Careers Have More Impact Than Others.

If you’re looking for a career where you can make a real impression, join HSBC and discover how valued you’ll be.

We are currently seeking an experienced professional to join our team in the role of Consultant Specialist.

Business: CTO Data Technology

Principal Responsibilities

  • Facilitate Agile ceremonies including Daily Stand-ups, Sprint Planning, Backlog Refinement, Sprint Review and Retrospective.
  • Coach teams on Agile/Scrum principles and continuously improve team maturity and delivery effectiveness.
  • Collaborate with stakeholders to understand business processes, pain points and strategic priorities.
  • Conduct analysis and documentation of business requirements, user journeys and system/process impacts.
  • Translate business requirements into clear user stories, acceptance criteria and functional specifications.
  • Partner with Product Owner and delivery teams to prioritize backlog items based on business value and dependencies.
  • Identify delivery risks, impediments and blockers; drive timely resolution and escalation where required.
  • Support UAT planning, test scenario definition and quality assurance alignment with business expectations.
  • Track and report sprint and release metrics (velocity, burn-down, cycle time, delivery predictability, quality indicators).
  • Build and maintain strong communication channels across business and technical teams to ensure transparency and alignment.
  • Identify opportunities for process optimization and propose practical, data-driven improvements.
  • Support change management, user enablement and post-implementation adoption activities.
  • Own end-to-end project management activities including project initiation, planning, execution, monitoring/control and closure.
  • Define and manage project scope, timeline, milestones, resource plan and budget to ensure on-time and within-budget delivery.
  • Establish and maintain RAID logs (Risks, Assumptions, Issues, Dependencies), governance cadence and escalation framework.
  • Drive cross-team/vendor coordination and dependency management across technology, operations and business units.
  • Prepare management reporting and steering committee updates on project health, delivery progress and decision points.
  • Ensure compliance with organizational standards, SDLC controls and audit/regulatory requirements where applicable.
  • Manage release readiness and implementation planning, including cutover, communication and post-go-live stabilization.
  • Support benefits tracking and realization against approved business case/objectives.

Requirements

  • University degree or above.
  • Minimum 10+ years of relevant working experience in technology/digital delivery, including proven experience in Scrum Master, Business Analyst, Project Manager, or hybrid delivery roles.
  • Strong understanding of Agile/Scrum delivery framework, SDLC and project management methodologies (Agile/Waterfall/Hybrid).
  • Strong analytical, problem-solving and stakeholder management skills.
  • Excellent written and verbal communication and facilitation skills.
  • Ability to work independently and collaboratively in a fast-paced, cross-functional environment.
  • Experience in requirement elicitation, process mapping, story writing and acceptance criteria definition.
  • Hands-on experience in project planning, dependency mapping, financial/budget tracking and resource management.
  • Experience with Agile and collaboration tools (e.g., JIRA, Confluence, Azure DevOps, MS Office, Power BI, MS Project).
  • High customer-centric mindset with commitment to quality and continuous improvement.
  • Ability to influence diverse stakeholders and drive outcomes under pressure.
  • Strong attention to detail with the ability to balance strategic and tactical priorities.
  • Experience in governance reporting, risk/issue management, and senior stakeholder/SteerCo communication.
  • Relevant certification(s) such as CSM/PSM, PMI-ACP, CBAP/CCBA, PMP/PRINCE2 would be an advantage.

/NA

You’ll achieve more when you join HSBC.

HSBC is an equal opportunity employer committed to building a culture where all employees are valued, respected and opinions count. We take pride in providing a workplace that fosters continuous professional development, flexible working and, opportunities to grow within an inclusive and diverse environment. We encourage applications from all suitably qualified persons irrespective of, but not limited to, their gender or genetic information, sexual orientation, ethnicity, religion, social status, medical care leave requirements, political affiliation, people with disabilities, color, national origin, veteran status, etc., We consider all applications based on merit and suitability to the role.

Personal data held by the Bank relating to employment applications will be used in accordance with our Privacy Statement, which is available on our website.

***Issued By HSBC Software Development (GuangDong) Limited Xian Branch***

We are currently seeking an experienced professional to join our team in the role of Consultant Specialist.

Business: CTO

Principal Responsibilities

  • Lead the end-to-end technical delivery of the Hong Kong customer system transformation to CDMS.
  • Analyse existing customer system flows across online and batch processes to identify common capabilities, market-specific journeys, and opportunities for simplification.
  • Design, implement, and support technical solutions for customer data management in the Hong Kong market.
  • Ensure technology solutions align with business priorities, customer outcomes, and broader transformation goals.
  • Drive both Run-the-Bank and Change-the-Bank requirements in line with strategic objectives.
  • Provide technical leadership across development, testing, migration, and production implementation activities.
  • Troubleshoot complex technical issues and guide teams toward practical, scalable solutions.

Data Management & Governance

  • Support the implementation of data governance standards, controls, and best practices.
  • Ensure high standards of data quality, integrity, security, and consistency across customer data platforms.
  • Translate business data requirements into effective technical solutions.

Stakeholder Management & Collaboration

  • Partner with business, operations, architecture, and engineering teams to deliver integrated solutions.
  • Communicate complex technical and data concepts clearly to a wide range of stakeholders.
  • Work effectively across global and distributed teams, influencing decisions and driving alignment.

Delivery Excellence

  • Apply Agile delivery practices, including Scrum and SAFe, to manage priorities and execution.
  • Leverage automation and AI-enabled tools to improve productivity across coding, testing, and migration.
  • Manage multiple workstreams effectively while maintaining delivery quality and timelines.

Requirements

  • Strong hands-on experience leading software development and technical delivery in large-scale banking environments.
  • Deep understanding of customer systems in Hong Kong
  • Solid experience with legacy/mainframe technologies, including:
  • MVS/z/Series/CICS/JCL/DB2/PROC
  • Knowledge of modern integration technologies, including:
  • APIs/Spring Boot/NoSQL databases such as MongoDB
  • Experience with AI tools and automation for software engineering, testing, and migration activities.

Functional & Domain Knowledge

  • Strong understanding of customer data domains, customer lifecycle processes, and front-line customer-facing platforms.
  • Experience delivering large-scale, complex transformation programmes in banking or financial services.
  • Good understanding of the regulatory environment in financial services, particularly data-related controls and compliance considerations.
  • Knowledge of enterprise operating models, governance, and change delivery within large organisations.

Leadership & Soft Skills

  • Proven leadership experience in driving teams through large-scale technology and cultural change.
  • Strong stakeholder management and influencing skills across business and technology functions.
  • Excellent communication skills, with the ability to present clearly and confidently to both technical and non-technical audiences.
  • Strong analytical, problem-solving, organisational, and time management skills.
  • Ability to manage competing priorities and deliver effectively in a fast-paced environment.

HSBC International Wealth and Premier Banking (IWPB)

Within International Wealth and Premier Banking (IWPB), we serve 41 million customers globally, including 6.7 million who are international, from retail customers to ultra high net worth individuals and their families. We help our customers to take care of their day-to-day finances and to manage, protect and grow their wealth. Our international network and breadth of expertise enable us to deliver on HSBC’s purpose of opening up a world of opportunity by providing our customers with borderless banking and world-class wealth management through best-in-class, mobile-first capabilities and exceptional people. Our key areas of operations include Retail Banking and Wealth Management, Asset Management, Global Private Banking and Insurance.

We are currently seeking an experienced professional to join our team.

In This Role, You Will

  • Developing our Premier customer base and establishing long term relationships with an assigned Premier clientele portfolio
  • Managing the total wealth of your clients by matching our financial and investment product solutions to their financial needs
  • Promoting our Premier Service to potential customers, exploring their needs and making referrals to other business units where appropriate
  • Supporting branch improvement initiatives, providing customer feedback of our service and ensuring compliance with audit requirements and quality assurance
  • 扩大卓越理财客户群，并与卓越理财客户建立长期关系
  • 根据客户的财务需求提供合适的金融及投资产品服务，管理客户的财富
  • 向潜在客户推广卓越理财服务，发掘他们的需求并且在适当的情况下推荐客户至其他业务部门
  • 配合执行分行改进措施，反映客户的意见，并确保符合分行的运作要求和品质保证

To be successful in the role, you should meet the following requirements:

  • University level education, preferably in finance, business or a related discipline
  • Experience in client facing environment, with excellent relationship building capability
  • Strong sales and customer orientation, with good communication and interpersonal skills
  • High level of customer centricity mindset with dedication to deliver exceptional quality services for customers
  • Good understanding and strong interest of the financial markets
  • Mature and independent mindset, able to work effectively under pressure
  • Strong commercial orientation with acute interpersonal skills
  • Fluency in Mandarin and English
  • 本科及以上学历，金融、商科或相关学科更佳
  • 具有前线客户服务经验，善于建立客户关系
  • 具有优秀销售及客户服务技巧，善于沟通及人际交流
  • 以客户为本，致力为客户提供优质服务
  • 了解并对金融市场有浓厚兴趣
  • 成熟独立，能在压力下有良好表现
  • 具有出色商业思维及敏锐人际技巧
  • 普通话及英语流利

You’ll achieve more at HSBC.

HSBC is committed to building a culture where all employees are valued, respected and opinions count. We take pride in providing a workplace that fosters continuous professional development, flexible working and opportunities to grow within and inclusive and diverse environment. Personal data held by the Bank relating to employment applications will be used in accordance with our Privacy Statement, which is available on our website.

  • Grounded, supported answer generation: Build generation workflows that produce grounded answers with explicit support (citations, quoted evidence snippets, and source metadata), including answer structuring, confidence/scoring signals, refusal/insufficient-evidence handling, and traceable “why this answer” outputs for auditability.

  • Cross-team collaboration: Partner with AI Infra, data platforms, information security, and product teams to land RAG capabilities in multiple systems and continuously evolve the platform.

  • Bachelor’s or Master’s degree in Computer Science, Software Engineering, or a related technical discipline.
  • 5+ years of backend engineering experience; strong proficiency in at least one mainstream backend stack: Python (FastAPI) or Go.

Principal Responsibilities

  • Reporting & stakeholders: The role reports to the Pod Lead (PO) or Product Manager (as defined by the pod operating model). The UI/UX Designer works day-to-day with Business Analysts, engineers (AI/ML Engineers, Forward Deployed Engineers and front-end/full-stack engineers), the QA/Testing Lead and the Tech Delivery Lead to ensure designs are buildable, testable and delivered to schedule. They partner closely with Change & Adoption Lead to support adoption through intuitive journeys and, where needed, in-product guidance. The role also collaborates with the AI Solution Architect, data/platform teams and the Responsible AI Practitioner to ensure AI-enabled experiences are transparent, safe and aligned to Group AI standards. Where required, they engage in Risk, Compliance, Legal, Privacy and Information Security to ensure that experience design supports approvals, required disclosures and evidence expectations in a regulated environment.
  • Scope & authority: The UI/UX Designer owns the end-to-end experience design for the pod’s AI-enabled features, from journey mapping and interaction design through to UI pattern definition, prototyping and usability validation. They are accountable for producing clear, build-ready design outputs - clickable prototypes, annotated user flows, content guidance and detailed design specifications (components, states, accessibility notes and error handling) - so delivery teams can implement with pace and minimal rework. They have the authority to propose and recommend experience options and trade-offs, grounded in user evidence and delivery constraints, including decisions around automation vs human oversight, transparency vs friction and handling of AI uncertainty and failure modes. Final decisions on product scope, investment and priority remain with the Pod Lead, but the UI/UX Designer is accountable for ensuring experience risks are surfaced early, addressed through design, and aligned to design system standards, Responsible AI expectations and required governance/approvals. The role does not own product prioritisation or backlog decisions; it influences these through tested prototypes, user evidence and clear experience trade-offs

Knowledge & Experience/Qualifications

  • This role exists to ensure AI-enabled solutions are designed around real user needs, are easy to use, and build trust - reducing rework and driving adoption. The UI/UX Designer brings clarity to complex AI behaviours through strong interaction design, validated journeys and production-ready specs.
  • Target journey & product definition - Partner with Pod Lead/PO, BA and business stakeholders to define the target user journeys and key moments that AI will improve. Translate AI capabilities/constraints (confidence, latency, failure modes, monitoring) into clear experience patterns and user expectations. Ensure the experience supports end-to-end outcomes, not isolated screens (e.g., request → decision/support → follow-up → audit trail).
  • UX discovery, research & testing standards - Plan and run lightweight discovery: stakeholder interviews, contextual enquiry, workflow walkthroughs and heuristic reviews. Define hypotheses and success measures for experience quality (task success, time-on-task, error rate, comprehension of AI outputs). Run rapid, repeatable usability testing on prototypes and early builds to validate journeys and UI patterns, synthesise findings, and drive iterative design improvements.
  • UI patterns, prototyping & design specification - Create wireframes and high-fidelity prototypes for key flows, edge cases and system states (loading, low confidence, refusal, escalation). Provide build-ready design specifications covering components, states, empty/error cases, accessibility notes, responsive behaviour and content guidance to support build and QA. Promote reuse by applying approved design systems and reusable components/patterns; propose new components only when justified and document rationale for reuse.
  • Design alignment to Responsible AI and control expectations - Embed “trust cues” and transparency: what the AI did, why, confidence/limits, and what users should do next. Design for safe use: appropriate human oversight, escalation paths, confirmation steps, and prevention of harmful/incorrect actions. Partner with Responsible AI Practitioner and control functions to ensure design supports required evidence and approvals (e.g., disclosures, decision records, audit trail touchpoints).
  • Delivery collaboration & quality in execution - Work closely with engineers and QA to ensure designs are implemented as intended; join backlog refinement and sprint ceremonies as needed. Support design QA: verify UI implementation, interaction fidelity, accessibility compliance and content accuracy. Keep design artefacts current (journey maps, prototypes, specs) so decisions remain traceable and delivery stays unblocked.
  • Adoption and change support (experience-led) - Partner with Change & Adoption Lead to ensure the solution is intuitive, learnable and supported by in-product guidance where needed. Identify friction points likely to reduce adoption and recommend design changes, onboarding or comms mitigations.

Ensure the experience supports end-to-end outcomes, not isolated screens (e.g., request → decision/support → follow-up → audit trail).
- UX discovery, research & testing standards - Plan and run lightweight discovery: stakeholder interviews, contextual enquiry, workflow walkthroughs and heuristic reviews. Define hypotheses and success measures for experience quality (task success, time-on-task, error rate, comprehension of AI outputs). Run rapid, repeatable usability testing on prototypes and early builds to validate journeys and UI patterns, synthesise findings, and drive iterative design improvements.

Provide build-ready design specifications covering components, states, empty/error cases, accessibility notes, responsive behaviour and content guidance to support build and QA. Promote reuse by applying approved design systems and reusable components/patterns; propose new components only when justified and document rationale for reuse.

Design for safe use: appropriate human oversight, escalation paths, confirmation steps, and prevention of harmful/incorrect actions. Partner with Responsible AI Practitioner and control functions to ensure design supports required evidence and approvals (e.g., disclosures, decision records, audit trail touchpoints).
- Delivery collaboration & quality in execution - Work closely with engineers and QA to ensure designs are implemented as intended; join backlog refinement and sprint ceremonies as needed. Support design QA: verify UI implementation, interaction fidelity, accessibility compliance and content accuracy. Keep design artefacts current (journey maps, prototypes, specs) so decisions remain traceable and delivery stays unblocked.
- Adoption and change support (experience-led) - Partner with Change & Adoption Lead to ensure the solution is intuitive, learnable and supported by in-product guidance where needed. Identify friction points likely to reduce adoption and recommend design changes, onboarding or comms mitigations.

Job Summary

Lead the global Post Trade Data technology organisation, accountable for the strategic data capabilities that underpin post trade services and processes across Markets.

Own the strategy, target architecture and investment roadmap for the Post Trade Data technology portfolio, including DQSL, SSDR, DQMA, DMR/Rosetta, FM-MIS and related services, establishing a unified and scalable data foundation for Post Trade Services.

  • Establish governed, discoverable and AI-ready data products with clear ownership, metadata, lineage, entitlements, privacy and control standards, enabling reliable reuse by Operations, Reporting, Regulatory and client-facing capabilities.
  • Drive platform convergence, application simplification, intelligent data-quality management, observability and automation to improve timeliness, consistency, resilience and cost efficiency.
  • Act as the senior technology partner for Markets Product, Markets COO, Operations, Data Office, Risk, Compliance, Architecture and Markets Technology leadership on post-trade data strategy, investment and transformation.

Key Responsibilities

The role holder leads others and is accountable for strategic direction, delivery outcomes, financial and technology risk management, stakeholder alignment and talent development across the global Post Trade Data technology organisation.

  • Strategy and transformation: Define and execute the multi-year Post Trade Data strategy, target architecture and investment roadmap, aligned to Markets Technology, Post Trade Services, enterprise data standards and regulatory priorities.
  • End-to-end capability ownership: Own the Post Trade Data application portfolio, including DQSL, SSDR, DQMA, DMR/Rosetta and related data services, with accountability for enterprise data ingestion, enrichment, distribution, quality, metadata, lineage, controls and governed data consumption across Post Trade Services. Maintain clear ownership of platform strategy, service performance, resilience, controls and lifecycle management.
  • Trusted and governed data: Establish authoritative data products and controls covering ownership, metadata, lineage, critical data elements, reconciliation, entitlements, security, privacy, retention and quality monitoring.
  • Architecture and modernisation: Converge fragmented data stores and pipelines toward reusable strategic services, including unified processing, data-quality and analytics layers, while reducing duplication, obsolescence and technical debt for the Post Trade Data ecosystem, including DQSL, SSDR, DQMA, DMR/Rosetta and related data services.
  • AI-ready foundations and innovation: Build governed data foundations for analytics and AI; apply intelligent data-quality controls, anomaly detection, automated lineage and AI-enabled engineering with appropriate security, model-risk and human oversight.
  • Resilience, controls and regulatory readiness: Ensure scalable, observable and recoverable data services; strengthen preventive and detective controls, audit evidence, cyber remediation and readiness for regulatory and country change.
  • Portfolio and financial governance: Accountable for portfolio investment decisions, delivery of strategic business cases, technology cost efficiency, workforce strategy, vendor management, run-and-change spend and realisation of platform simplification and productivity benefits.
  • Stakeholder and people leadership: Partner with Product, Operations, Reporting, Regulatory Technology, Data Office, Risk, Compliance, Architecture and Cyber Security; lead a global team with clear accountability, succession and engineering excellence.

People and Talent

  • Set direction and drive high performance by translating strategy into clear direction, aligning individual goals to team outcomes and providing regular, constructive feedback.
  • Develop talent and capability through coaching and career conversations that build critical skills, stretch potential and prepare individuals for future opportunities.
  • Lead by example by role-modelling the Bank’s valued behaviours, upholding strong risk and conduct standards, exercising sound judgment, and creating an inclusive team culture that supports wellbeing, values diverse perspectives, and drives accountability.

Skills And Experience

Must-have Skills

  • Post Trade Data Architecture and Engineering
  • Data Governance, Quality and Lineage
  • Technology Strategy, Innovation and AI Enablement

Other Skills

  • Technology Platform and Engineering Leadership
  • Data Risk, Controls and Regulatory Readiness
  • People Leadership and Team Culture
  • Strategic Stakeholder and Portfolio Management

Motivations

This role is energised by turning complex, fragmented post-trade data into trusted, reusable and strategically valuable enterprise capabilities.

  • Building high-performing global data engineering teams and a culture where data ownership, quality, resilience and control are embedded by design.
  • Delivering measurable improvements in data timeliness, consistency, discoverability, reuse, operational resilience and time-to-insight.
  • Creating governed and AI-ready foundations that accelerate reporting, analytics, automation and decision support across Post Trade Services.

Qualifications

Key Experiences

  • Demonstrable experience leading enterprise-scale data platforms, streaming and processing capabilities, data-quality controls, governance and analytics enablement in production environments.
  • Strong technical credibility to challenge data architecture, integration, cloud, security, lineage and control decisions and translate them into business and operational outcomes.
  • 15+ years of Financial Markets technology experience with significant leadership responsibility across enterprise data platforms. Demonstrated experience delivering real-time ingestion and processing, data-quality management, governance, lineage, distribution, analytics or AI-ready data foundations, platform modernisation and resilience.
  • Proven ability to lead global teams, manage material investment and vendor portfolios, and deliver resilient, governed and scalable data outcomes.

Certifications / Qualifications

  • Bachelor's degree required; Master's degree or equivalent postgraduate qualification preferred.
  • Relevant certifications in Data Management, Data Architecture, Cloud Engineering, AI/ML, Data Governance or Enterprise Architecture are advantageous.

Languages

  • English required. Additional regional language capability is beneficial for global team and stakeholder engagement.

About Standard Chartered

We're a global bank connecting clients to our differentiated network, offering growth opportunities in the world's most dynamic markets. Our strategy, which combines cross-border capabilities and leading wealth management expertise, helps us deliver our purpose - to drive commerce and prosperity through our unique diversity.

Over our 170-year history, and across a unique geographical footprint connecting Asia, Africa and the Middle East to each other and the world, we've built a bank like no other, with diverse capabilities and partnerships that set us apart.

What We Offer

  • Being part of an inclusive and values driven organisation, one that embraces and celebrates our unique diversity, across our teams, business functions, and geographies.
  • In line with our Fair Pay Charter, we offer a competitive salary and benefits to support your mental, physical, financial and social wellbeing.
  • Core bank funding for retirement savings, medical and life insurance, with flexible and voluntary benefits available in some locations.
  • Time-off including annual leave, parental/maternity (20 weeks), sabbatical (12 months maximum) and volunteering leave (3 days), along with minimum global standards for annual and public holiday, which is combined to 30 days minimum.
  • Flexible working options based around home and office locations, with flexible working patterns.
  • Proactive wellbeing support through Unmind, a market-leading digital wellbeing platform, development courses for resilience and other human skills, global employee assistance programme, sick leave, mental health first-aiders and self-help toolkits.
  • A continuous learning culture to support your growth, with opportunities to reskill and upskill and access to physical, virtual, and digital learning.

Visit our careers website to learn more about us: www.sc.com/careers.

Position Purpose

  • Client relationship management of a portfolio of medium to large PRC corporate mainly located in Central China regions;
  • Origination of business opportunities to achieve revenue target and business objectives;
  • Risk monitoring and exposure management of the client portfolio.

Direct Responsibilities

Client marketing :

  • To prepare & implement Relationship Plans (Client Action Plans) and global account strategy.
  • To explore new client relationship in Central China region with the selection criteria of Corporate Coverage Group.
  • To maintain, understand and closely follow-up client’s business evolution, management & corporate strategy and banking needs via frequent marketing calls to client at all levels.
  • To identify and originate business cross-selling opportunities and enlarge wallet share for the bank. Introduction of the bank’s latest offered products / development to relevant clients.
  • To prepare and distribute call reports / client information to product lines and management.
  • To drive product specialist / lines on structuring, pitching, negotiation, pricing, bidding and execution of business mandates.
  • To update relevant management levels of business lines, head office and other branches on client’s business development, credit evolution and answer to their queries.
  • To maximize client profitability in a product neutral manner.

Risk / Exposure Responsibilities

  • To manage risk exposure of client groups.
  • To perform credit application with risk analysis and monitoring, to supervise credit process, to procure quality credit proposals & presentations.
  • To coordinate all negotiations of banking documents between the clients and related internal parties.
  • Ensure compliance with Bank’s policies/procedures and regulatory requirements, in particular with regards to the KYC responsibilities and duties, as per relevant policies and procedures, and the summary of responsibilities list attached hereto.
  • An appendix (in attachment), is also to be systematically attached to the RM JD:

– Appendix –

Summary of SBO/SCBO Responsibilities pertaining to Know Your Customer and AML/Sanctions Policies

Responsibilities

The RM, who is responsible for the client relationship in the Primary Site/Secondary Site (as defined in the Global KYC Policy):

  • must initiate the KYC on boarding process and is responsible to collect the KYC data (with support of the appropriate teams in charge of due diligence);
  • is primarily responsible for ensuring that customer due diligence has been completed to a satisfactory standard, and is kept up-to-date;
  • makes an assessment whether starting a new relationship or maintaining an existing relationship with a customer is appropriate, in respect of the reputation and the money laundering/terrorist financing/sanctions risks, irrespective of the possible type of business the customer is currently doing or intends to do with the bank. This assessment must be formalized in writing in the KYC package (including a qualitative RM Assessment describing the risks and their mitigants , which is mandatory in all cases);
  • uses the KYC scoring grid and his/her judgment to determine the sensitivity, assisted by the teams in charge of due diligence. He/she provides the teams in charge of due diligence with the knowledge/details they need when contacts with customers is required;
  • submits the customer’s KYC file to the CAC (Customer Acceptance Committee), as may be required, and provides the CAC with all information and documentation it may require;
  • contributes to assess the relevance and appropriateness of offering and/or maintaining certain products and services of the Bank in view of the risk profile of the customer;
  • contributes to the detection of any unusual and/or suspicious transactions by his/her customer with due reporting to a Compliance Officer;
  • and employs his/her best efforts to maintain a thorough knowledge of his/her customer from available documentary sources and regular direct contacts with them.
  • finally, he/she must keep the KYC up-to date in accordance with the Bank’s standards. In particular, he/she must trigger an ad-hoc review as soon as necessary, notably in case of becoming aware of any material adverse information in connection with any of their customers in the field of AML-CTF, in accordance with the relevant KYC policies and procedures.

Case Of Passporting Process (except WM RM)

  • When acting as Secondary Site RM of Legal Entities benefiting from the passport procedure, responsibility of the Secondary Site RM is to acknowledge and approve, on behalf of the Secondary Site, the KYC onboarding or recertification due diligence (performed and completed by the Primary Site) for Legal Entities being rated medium risk and low risk, and submit the customer’s KYC file to a CAC for a Legal Entity being rated high risk by the Primary Site.

Contributing Responsibilities

  • To perform & ensure satisfaction of “Know-Your-Client-KYC” & relevant compliance requirement at client / transaction levels.
  • To assist Team Head in annual budgeting, Risk Policies recommendation & implementation as well as other management objectives of the bank.
  • To coach Credit Analysts and Facility Assistants in relationship management, client servicing & credit and documentation issues.
  • To procure smooth coordination & good working relationship with product lines, risk function and other business units. To assist answering of inquiries from external regulatory bodies (internal auditors, CBRC, SAFE etc.)

Permanent Control Aspects

  • Direct contribution to BNPP operational permanent control framework.
  • Contribute to the implementation of operational permanent control policies and procedures in day-to-day business activities, such as Control Plan
  • Comply with regulatory requirements and internal guidelines
  • Contribute to the reporting of all incidents according to the Incident Management System
  • Ensure audit recommendations are implemented within the specific timeline.
  • Endeavor to ensure the quality of the Bank's portfolio remains sound and healthy.

Technical & Behavioral Competencies

  • - University Degree holder in Finance or equivalent
  • At least 7-8 years of relationship management experience in Corporate Banking or related areas
  • Fluent in spoken and written English and Chinese
  • Excellent sense of credit / risk and good financial analytical skills
  • Experience in relationship building with large corporate groups
  • Good sense of cross-selling and strong product knowledge
  • Good comprehension, presentation & interpersonal skills
  • Strong knowledge on bank documentation (e.g. loan documents, ISDA/NAFMII)
  • Good knowledge and understanding of CBRC regulations
  • Good presentation & structuring skills in written presentation, quantitative modeling and pitch books Power Point)

  • Strategy development and execution: Support the Director of IDP in shaping and refreshing the function's strategy – conducting analysis, developing options and recommendations, translating agreed direction into objectives, roadmaps and measurable outcomes, and tracking delivery against them.
  • Operating rhythm and governance: Run the operating rhythm for the Director of IDP and the leadership team – setting agendas, preparing materials, capturing decisions and actions, and driving follow-through to closure.
  • Team effectiveness and organisational health: Support the Director of IDP on organisational and team matters, including onboarding, colleague engagement, internal communications, capability planning and cultural initiatives that sustain a high-performing global team.
  • Special initiatives: Lead strategic initiatives and analyses on behalf of the Director of IDP where dedicated focus is required, from framing the problem through to a decision-ready recommendation and implementation.

Leadership & Teamwork

  • Lead the Leveraging Strategic Partnerships workstream through matrix leadership of contributors across partnership, innovation and technology teams in multiple jurisdictions, without direct line authority.
  • Bring cohesion to the IDP China leadership team – connecting agendas, surfacing tensions early, and holding colleagues to the commitments they have made

Requirements

  • Programme management: Proven track record of managing complex, multi-stakeholder programmes or workstreams in a large organisation – planning, dependency and risk management, governance, and reporting into senior programme structures.
  • Strategic analysis: Ability to structure ambiguous problems, conduct rigorous analysis, and develop clear, decision-ready recommendations for a senior audience.
  • Executive communication: Exceptional written and verbal communication, with demonstrable experience producing materials for executive and Board-level audiences.
  • Stakeholder engagement: Strong grasp of engaging with diverse stakeholders, covering business, technology and external partnerships, to align innovation efforts with bank priorities.
  • AI: Working knowledge of artificial intelligence and its practical application in financial services – sufficient to engage credibly with technical colleagues and strategic partners, and to translate technical progress into business terms.
  • Partnerships: Understanding of how strategic technology and AI partnerships are structured, governed and commercially realised within a large, regulated organisation.
  • Strategic: Proven track record in translating strategy into executable plans and measurable outcomes.
